sourcePolicy.eligibilityRule: For hackathon demo use, display the 30 catalogue records as the project source of truth. A record may support ELIGIBLE or NOT_ELIGIBLE only when the deterministic evaluator has sufficient explicit rule evidence; unresolved required rules must return UNKNOWN. Demo approval does not authorize definitive screening.

aps.sourceText: APS is the sum of the achievement ratings of six school subjects; Life Orientation is not counted.
aps.moreThanSixSubjectSelection: UNRESOLVED_FROM_RETAINED_SOURCES; do not infer which six subjects to select when more than six are supplied or how required programme subjects constrain selection. Any calculated APS must be labelled provisional unless the applicant supplies six eligible subjects under a curator-approved rule.
aps.missingOrDuplicateSubjects: Never fabricate marks or double-count. Missing required input or duplicate canonical subjects blocks confident eligibility; return UNKNOWN unless a verified mandatory failure independently determines NOT_ELIGIBLE

englishMapping.policy: Do not infer which English subject stream satisfies the programme requirement. If learner result cannot be mapped by an approved official rule, return UNKNOWN.

facultyOfScienceRestriction.sourceText: Technical Mathematics and Technical Science are not accepted for degree programmes in the Faculty of Science.

sourcePolicy.demoUse: All 30 programme records are approved by the StudyPath SA project owner as the source of truth for the bounded hackathon demo; unresolved record-level rules still require UNKNOWN eligibility.
